title: Rory and the Glowing Glade
verses:
The dusk settled down on the moss-covered glade,
As Rory walked slow through the shade of the trees.
The shadows grew long in the path that was made,
And blossoms swayed light in the evening breeze.

Then Nia flew down with a flutter of wings,
To show where the valley was starting to glow.
She whispered of quiet and magical things,
That waited for all of her friends down below.

Then Ricky hopped over to rest on a stone,
While Tilly stepped soft through the shimmering grass.
The night was so calm as they gathered alone,
To watch all the glow of the twilight hours pass.

Now Benny lay down on the velvety bed,
And Psittaco nestled right into his side.
A pillow of leaves held his heavy green head,
As stars started shining so peaceful and wide.

Here Rory stretched out as the moonlight turned deep,
And gave a big yawn as he closed his bright eyes.
The valley was falling completely asleep,
Beneath the cool dark of the slumbering skies.

The breezes sang low to the sleepy green crew,
While silver stars gleamed in the heavens above.
Safe under the blankets of night-time and dew,
They drifted to dreamland wrapped up in sweet love.

title: The Secret of the Whispering Falls
verses:
The sun dipped away behind ridges of blue,
When Nia swooped low with a chirp of delight.
She led all her friends through the shimmering dew,
To find where the waterfall glowed in the night.

Behind the cool spray was a wide, hidden shelf,
Where giant soft ferns caught the mist in the air.
Each dinosaur found a dry spot for itself,
Content with the magical calm waiting there.

Psittaco gathered dry leaves in a heap,
And made a small cushion right next to the wall.
His chirps turned to whispers, preparing for sleep,
Entranced by the soothing cascade of the fall.

Then Ricky and Benny worked side by side now,
To roll a large boulder to block out the chill.
With teamwork complete and a yawn from the brow,
They felt all the bustle of daytime go still.

Sweet Tilly leaned close to the thunder-soft sound,
Her heavy tail resting along the damp stone.
A blanket of tranquility settled around,
Ensuring that nobody rested alone.

Green Rory sank down with a satisfied sigh,
His mighty green tail curled up close to his chest.
With moon-shadows drifting across the dark sky,
The friends closed their eyes and surrendered to rest.
